read.title: Key Terms of the Draft Agreement
read.text:
Dear Mr. Nguyen,

Thank you for the productive call last week. Please find below the key terms of our draft agreement.

Your territory will be Vietnam, and the agreement will run for two years from the signing date. The sales target is 200,000 dollars in the first year. If the target is met, you are entitled to a 5% rebate on the following year's orders.

Either party may terminate the agreement with 90 days' written notice. All marketing materials must be used in accordance with our brand guidelines.

Please review the attached draft and send us your comments by next Friday.

Best regards,
Minsu Lee

write.en: Email a potential Thai distributor the key terms of the draft agreement (territory, period, first-year sales target) and ask for comments.
write.model:
Dear Ms. Suda,

Please find attached our draft agreement. Your territory will be Thailand, and the agreement will run for two years. The sales target for the first year is 150,000 dollars. If you meet it, you are entitled to a 3% rebate. Could you review the draft and send us your comments by June 10?

Best regards,
Minsu Lee
